name.en-US: The Precious Blood, or the Price of Our Salvation
name.pt-BR: O Preciosíssimo Sangue, ou o Preço da Nossa Salvação

description.en-US: Faber's treatise of 1860 on devotion to the Precious Blood, written for the Confraternity of the Precious Blood at the London Oratory: its mystery, its necessity, its empire, its history, its prodigality and the devotion to it.
description.pt-BR: O tratado de Faber (1860) sobre a devoção ao Preciosíssimo Sangue, escrito para a Confraria do Preciosíssimo Sangue do Oratório de Londres: o seu mistério, a sua necessidade, o seu império, a sua história, a sua prodigalidade e a devoção a ele.

en-US.editor: Fr. Frederick William Faber (tenth American edition, Baltimore: John Murphy)

sources.edition: The Precious Blood, or the Price of our Salvation (Baltimore: John Murphy, tenth American edition, 1860), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The dedicatory letter to the members of the Confraternity is kept; the contents page and the index are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Fr. Frederick William Faber died in 1863 and the edition is of 1860, so the text is public domain.
